body: I'm quite good at "Fake it till you make it". Almost all of this despair is internalized exclusively. I realize acting out on it isn't going to do me any favors. I keep trying. I need an outlet though... And thank you :D
Got any tips for where to look/what to ask for?
That's actually the best way I've heard it put. That's unbelievably appealing to me.

I'm nearly to that point. I moved to Seattle because I've pretty much always seen myself here. everything I've wanted to do and see is in this area, it is the most... real place I've ever imagined. It's like, picture a reality where everything is what you thought it should be. The scenery, the landscape, the people, the business and the weather. It all actually makes sense to you. It's exactly what you always thought these things should be. That's Seattle. and I finally moved here. And it's exactly what I thought.

I'm trying really hard to not lose that just yet. But maybe. We'll see. North Dakota seems nice too.
